description: Perth Metro Archive (LGATE-332) is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Landgate. This Perth Metro Archive imagery service provides Perth metropolitan aerial imagery as individual layers captured from 1947 through to the end of 2009. Perth Metro imagery from 2010 onwards can be found here A subscription to Perth Metro will automatically include access to Perth Metro Archive at no extra charge. The services cannot be separated. Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Landgate. Its tags are 1900s imagery, Metropolitan Perth, Perth, Perth Metro, Perth aerial mosaic. It offers 4 resource(s) in esri rest, esri rest - token, pdf, wms. The portal shows 2025-09-01 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Custom (Other). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
